name: beaam
description: Quietly monitor a production stack and investigate what needs attention.

interface.shortDescription: Quiet monitoring for the stack behind your product.
interface.longDescription: Connect Beaam to inspect service health, investigate incidents, review monitoring coverage, and make requested monitoring changes without leaving Codex or ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Check whether anything in my stack needs attention.
Investigate my latest incident and explain the likely cause.
Review my monitoring coverage and tell me what is missing.
